Transaction account wrapper with constructors, accessors, mutators, and borrow tracking.

# Purpose
Defines the `fd_txn_account_t` interface used to wrap a Solana account record during transaction execution. The file declares the account state structure, its memory layout constants, and the constructor, join, leave, and delete functions that manage ownership of the account metadata and data. It also declares helpers for initializing an account from `funk` in readonly or mutable mode, publishing mutable changes, and reading or updating fields such as owner, lamports, executable state, rent epoch, and data length. Borrowing and reference-count style access control are also exposed through functions such as [`fd_txn_account_try_borrow_mut`](<#fd_txn_account_try_borrow_mut>), [`fd_txn_account_drop`](<#fd_txn_account_drop>), [`fd_txn_account_is_mutable`](<#fd_txn_account_is_mutable>), and [`fd_txn_account_is_readonly`](<#fd_txn_account_is_readonly>).
